full: The Data Governance Specialist will support the Head of Data in implementing and operating the enterprise data governance framework. This role will ensure data quality, consistency, compliance, and responsible usage across business units. The executive will collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to implement policies, standards, and controls that align with regulatory requirements and business objectives. I. Key Responsibilities: Support the development and enforcement of data governance policies, standards, and procedures. Support the development of the enterprise-wide Master Data Management (MDM) principles, processes, and tools. Work closely with business units and IT to define master data domains, data hierarchies, and ownership models. Oversee creation and maintenance of the data catalogue, business glossary, and data lineage documentation. Monitor and report on data quality metrics for critical master data elements (e.g., customer, product, store, vendor). Lead data stewardship efforts to ensure consistent and accurate master data across systems. Executing data cleansing, enrichment, deduplication, and harmonization. Ensure data compliance with privacy regulations (PDPA, GDPR), internal policies, and audit requirements. Participate in cross-functional projects involving data integration, ERP, POS, CDP, and enterprise data platforms. Promote awareness and adoption of data governance and MDM best practices across the organization. II. Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data governance, master data management, or data stewardship roles. Strong knowledge of MDM concepts, data lifecycle management, and master data domain definitions. Experience defining and governing master data (e.g., customer, product, vendor, store) in ERP/POS & CDP platforms. Understanding of data quality frameworks, metadata management, and governance tools. Knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., Vietnam PDPA, GDPR) related to data handling. Ability to collaborate with IT and business teams to align data governance with operational needs. Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills. Nice-to-Have Experience with MDM or governance platforms such as Informatica MDM, Microsoft Purview Understanding of Azure Data Services, Databricks, and ERP/POS & CDP data integration. Background in retail, F&B, or multi-brand consumer businesses. Soft Skills Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills. Collaborative mindset with a proactive attitude. Ability to balance governance enforcement with business practicality. full: Tiếp nhận yêu cầu và quản lý Backlog: Đầu mối tiếp nhận nhu cầu dữ liệu từ các Khối nghiệp vụ/dự án; xác định phạm vi yêu cầu (Data Scope), quản trị Backlog và điều phối giữa đơn vị nghiệp vụ với các team kỹ thuật (DE/BI/DS) của Phòng Dữ liệu và Phân tích. Phân tích và đặc tả yêu cầu dữ liệu: Phối hợp, tư vấn đơn vị nghiệp vụ hoàn thiện tài liệu đặc tả yêu cầu (BRD), bảo đảm yêu cầu rõ ràng, đo lường được và phục vụ đúng mục tiêu khai thác số liệu. Xây dựng tài liệu Data Mapping: Phân tích hệ thống nguồn, chuyển hóa BRD thành tài liệu Data Mapping chi tiết để bàn giao chính xác cho các team DE/BI/DS. Thiết kế mô hình dữ liệu và chuẩn hóa: Phối hợp với bộ phận Kiến trúc dữ liệu, DE thiết kế mô hình dữ liệu phù hợp; đề xuất cải tiến và chuẩn hóa kiến trúc, định nghĩa chỉ tiêu (metric definitions) của hệ thống dữ liệu. Kiểm thử và nghiệm thu số liệu (SIT/UAT): Thực hiện kiểm thử hệ thống (SIT); phối hợp đơn vị nghiệp vụ kiểm thử người dùng (UAT), đối chiếu số liệu theo tiêu chí đã thống nhất và hoàn thiện hồ sơ nghiệm thu bàn giao (Sign-off). Phối hợp triển khai giải pháp: Làm việc với các bộ phận chức năng, đối tác và nhà cung cấp để tìm giải pháp cho yêu cầu kỹ thuật, phục vụ quá trình phát triển và triển khai giải pháp dữ liệu. 1. Trình độ Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên (hệ chính quy) chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Hệ thống thông tin quản lý, Tài chính - Ngân hàng hoặc các ngành định lượng tương đương. 2. Kinh nghiệm Tối thiểu 02 năm làm việc trong lĩnh vực CNTT/Dữ liệu tại các tổ chức tài chính, ngân hàng, với vai trò Data BA, Data Analyst hoặc tương đương. Am hiểu các mảng kinh doanh (Bán lẻ, SME, Khối Số), hệ thống chỉ tiêu tài chính (KPI, Metric, CASA, NIM) và các thông tư, quy định của Ngân hàng Nhà nước. Am hiểu nghiệp vụ của các hệ thống lõi ngân hàng (T24, Thẻ, Kondor, Giải ngân...) hoặc các phần mềm ứng dụng chuyên sâu tương đương. 3. Kỹ năng a. Kỹ năng Phân tích dữ liệu SQL & Khai thác dữ liệu: Thành thạo SQL/Python để truy vấn, xử lý và phân tích tập dữ liệu lớn trên DWH/Data Lake. Kiểm thử số liệu (Data Testing): Thực hiện kiểm thử SIT/UAT và logic nghiệp vụ, bảo đảm độ chính xác trước khi vận hành. Phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ (Root Cause): Tìm nguyên nhân lỗi hệ thống/quy trình để giải quyết bài toán kinh doanh và đề xuất cải tiến. Báo cáo & Trực quan hóa: Thiết kế dashboard/báo cáo quản trị bằng công cụ BI (Power BI, Superset). b. Sử dụng Công cụ Xử lý dữ liệu: SQL, Python. Trực quan hóa (BI): Power BI, Superset (hoặc tương đương). Vẽ quy trình & Luồng dữ liệu: Visio, Draw.io, Lucidchart. Quản lý dự án & Cộng tác: Jira, Confluence (Mô hình Agile/Scrum). Tin học văn phòng: Excel, Word, PowerPoint. c. Kỹ năng mềm Tư duy & Giải quyết vấn đề: Tư duy phản biện, tiếp cận vấn đề có cấu trúc, chủ động đề xuất giải pháp sáng tạo. Truyền đạt & "Phiên dịch" dữ liệu: Chuyển hóa kỹ thuật phức tạp thành ngôn ngữ kinh doanh dễ hiểu; bảo vệ giải pháp tốt. Quản lý công việc & Đa nhiệm: Sắp xếp ưu tiên theo giá trị kinh doanh, quản lý đa nhiệm và bảo đảm tiến độ. Điều phối liên chức năng: Kết nối và tạo đồng thuận giữa khối kinh doanh, team kỹ thuật (DE/BI/DS/AI) và đối tác.

full: Position Overview: At Madison Technologies, we don't just deliver reports; we operate as a seamless extension of our client's internal teams. Your goal is to move from being a "task-taker" to a "trusted advisor" who understands their business as well as they do. We are seeking a technically proficient and business-savvy Data Analyst to join our team at Madison Technologies. This role is designed for an individual who can bridge the gap between complex data engineering and strategic business growth. You will leverage modern data platforms and AI to optimize core business metrics and automate manual workflows, ensuring we deliver high-impact results for our global clients. Key Responsibilities: 1. Finance Data and ERP Readiness • Finance Current-State Assessment: Interview the chief accountant and finance teams to map how exchange rates, timezones and COD (cash-on-delivery) reconciliation are handled today, and set a baseline for current reconciliation time. • Odoo Data Design: Define the data format, schema and table list needed to feed the Data Warehouse into Odoo, including a single FX source, matching keys, COD thresholds, chart of accounts and multi-company setup. • Automated Reconciliation: Design rules for order-level reconciliation so margin can be tracked by SKU, channel and campaign, and COD losses go down. 2. Single Source of Truth and Business Glossary • Metric Inventory: Extract every measure and calculated field from Power BI, Looker Studio, Lark and Google Sheets, compare them for the same period in SQL, and find the root cause of the top 10 mismatched metrics. • Business Glossary: Build and get owner sign-off on the first 20–30 core metrics (ROAS, CPA, CVR, COGS, gross profit, margin), each with definition, formula, grain and owner, plus one agreed attribution model, committed as version-controlled dbt YAML. • Partner Reporting: Rebuild the definition of the monthly partner report (metrics, formulas, grain, tenant) so it can be fully automated in a multi-tenant setup. • Suggested Metrics and Reports: Propose department-level metric marts and executive KPIs, each with a measured baseline, so the program can show real business impact. 3. Business Discovery and Stakeholder Management • Multi-Market Interviews: Run structured business interviews with HQ and each of the 9 markets, and send meeting minutes within 24 hours. • Business Growth Strategy: Lay the groundwork for customer profiling, RFM segmentation and cohort analysis to support retargeting, repeat purchase and lifetime value growth. • Progress Reporting: Report OKR status (on track, at risk, off track) in weekly client meetings and contribute to the final readout and go/no-go recommendation. Qualifications: • Experience: 3+ years as a Data Analyst or Business Analyst, ideally in e-commerce, retail or fintech, or with a bachelor's degree in a related quantitative field. • Advanced SQL: Expert-level ability to write complex queries on BigQuery (window functions, CTEs, reconciliation queries) to compare and validate numbers across sources. • Programming: Working knowledge of Python for data analysis and automation. • Executive Visualization: Proficiency in Power BI (DAX) and Looker Studio, including reverse-engineering existing dashboards into clear, KPI-focused tools for C-level stakeholders. • Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with BigQuery. Familiarity with dbt (YAML, metrics) and Git, and experience building a business glossary or semantic layer, is a plus. • Product and Marketing Analytics: Hands-on experience with ROAS, CPA, CVR, attribution models and ad platform data (Meta and others); exposure to RFM, churn and LTV analysis is a plus. • Integrated Business Systems: Understanding of revenue recognition, multi currency accounting, COD flows and margin calculation. Experience with Odoo or another ERP, Pancake or Lark/Larkbase is a strong plus. • Linguistic Proficiency: Native Vietnamese for business interviews, plus excellent command of English (both written and verbal), ability to present data narratives to stakeholders. • Location: Based at our Da Nang office. Why Join Madison Technologies: • Global Exposure: Partner directly with clients across the US, EU and SEA, delivering high-impact solutions in an elite international environment. • Diverse Domain Mastery: Rapidly expand your toolkit by solving complex data challenges across various industries from Healthcare, Fintech, E-commerce. Income/Benefit: • Competitive salary package (negotiable based on experience). • Opportunity for long-term growth in a leadership role. Contact Information: If you are interested in this opportunity, please send your CV to: recruitment@madison.dev For more information about us: https://madison-technologies.com/

full: YOUR NEW ROLE This role is for CODE LEAP's client company - JTL-Software JTL-Software is one of Germany's leading providers of e-commerce and ERP solutions. More than 50,000 retailers rely on JTL every day to run their business. Our global development center in Vietnam is looking for talented people to build the next generation of these products. You'll work in an international team that pairs German software quality and Vietnamese speed to innovate. Tens of thousands of merchants run their business on JTL. Their data, every order, article and stock movement, is spread across thousands of local systems, where it works for no one. We are changing that. The Customer Data Platform brings merchant data into the cloud, securely and with permission, and turns it into answers merchants can act on. It is the foundation beneath our new BI product, our AI agent Juno and every data product JTL will build next. A first version already runs end to end. Now we are taking it from a handful of pilot merchants to a foundation built for thousands. We are a new, small and senior team with a clear mandate, a modern stack (Python, DuckDB, dbt, PostgreSQL, Dagster, Azure, Terraform) and an AI-native way of working: specs and decision records first, coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex doing much of the implementation, humans owning design, review and judgement. You own the data path: from the moment a merchant's delivery arrives, through validation and nightly builds, to versioned business views that products can trust. Nothing lost, nothing counted twice, no half finished state ever visible, for thousands of merchants at once. We are hiring two Data Engineers with complementary profiles, from Mid-Level to Staff , and set the level with you, based on your experience. The team spans Germany and Vietnam: two senior engineering leaders in Germany and three engineers in Ho Chi Minh City. You will work directly with the German leads, with our internal data team and with the product teams that build on the platform. Working language is English; we work asynchronously by default and meet daily in a shared overlap window. YOUR EXCITING TASKS Design and build tenant-isolated transformation layers with dbt and DuckDB, from raw deliveries to clean, versioned business views. Define data contracts for ERP source tables (orders, articles, stock, invoices) and extend them to new sources step by step. Build idempotent, replayable pipelines: deliveries may arrive twice, results never do. Orchestrate nightly runs per merchant with Dagster, with retries, blast-radius limits and alerts that say what happened. Automate data quality and end-to-end checks into every pull request. Model the metrics products ask for, revenue, margin, stock, reorder signals, together with the product teams. Work agent-first: specify, then let Claude Code and Codex implement, orchestrate agents across pipelines and models, triage pipeline issues with them, and own the review. Keep cost per merchant transparent and low. YOUR PROFILE AND YOUR PERSONALITY 6+ years (Senior) building production data pipelines. Excellent SQL and strong Python; you can read a query plan and you test what you ship. Hands-on experience with dbt (or comparable) and analytical engines such as DuckDB, Spark, Snowflake or BigQuery. Experience with an orchestrator such as Dagster or Airflow. A solid grasp of analytical data modelling: incremental loads, idempotency, late and duplicate deliveries. Experience with relational sources (Microsoft SQL Server or similar) and PostgreSQL. Hands-on, daily experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex: you design agent workflows, orchestrate agents on real work and know when not to trust them. Clear written and spoken English and a habit of writing things down. Nice To Have Multi-tenant data platforms, tenant isolation and row-level security. Data contracts and schema evolution. Terraform, Azure or GitHub Actions. Semantic or metrics layers (MetricFlow, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube). Building agent tooling: MCP servers, custom skills, agent evals, automated issue triage or AI-assisted data operations. E-commerce or ERP data. Our teams in Berlin (Germany) and Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam) work hand in hand to develop state-of-the-art solutions of the highest quality. Because collaborating with the right people is the secret to our successful growth. We future-proof organizations - be part of it!

Ngân hàng TMCP Á Châu (ACB) là một trong những ngân hàng có thực lực và được xếp vào tốp đầu nhóm ngân hàng cổ phần tại Việt Nam. ACB hướng đến hình ảnh một ngân hàng mạnh về kết quả tài chính, quản lý rủi ro, đạo đức kinh doanh và tiên phong trong việc sáng tạo nên những sản phẩm, dịch vụ đáp ứng các nhu cầu của khách hàng trên thị trường hiện nay.
